comparison_model: Each of four equal-length bow subregions must carry midpoint calculation evidence and reported F, Q, P and AR values. Select the maxima of F, Q and P for downstream Pavg, b and w calculations. I2-014 does not itself supply arithmetic equations equating or deriving these quantities.
source_basis: IACS UR I2.3.2.1(ii): bow region generally divided into four equal-length sub-regions; F, Q, P and AR calculated at each mid-length; maxima of F, Q and P used downstream.

cases.rationale: Four represented subregions have midpoint values, evidence, F/Q/P/AR, and the selected F/Q/P values equal the maxima.
cases.oracle: Exactly four complete subregion cases; each has midpoint/evidence/F/Q/P/AR; selected F/Q/P equal represented maxima.
